pages.text: I only know this one secondhand, so bear with me.

There's a forest where it's always dusk. You get there through a small pool ringed with flowers, if you throw a diamond in. Deep inside there's a lich at the top of a tower. The tower won't open until you've beaten the great snake first.
$(o)The Twilight Lich hoards the Magical Eye at the top of his tower in the Twilight Forest. Beat the Naga first, or the door stays shut.$()
